If the facts don't fit the theory, change the facts.
The Prototype of Dimensionally Transcendent Plasma Forge
Better at continuous long-term operation and mass production.
But it is not good enough in miniaturization.
Reach the best operating state after 24 hours of continuous operation, reducing 75% fuel consumption.
After stopping operation, the fuel consumption reduction rate will quickly decrease to 0% within 1 hours.
Installing module hatches near the controller block can significantly improve machine performance.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Output Hatch, Energy Hatch
[note]Structure[/note]: Heating Coils (the coil tier matters); the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.
